interpretation: Different illustrative loss assumptions, not an improvement to the physical vehicle. Both use identical designs, full cycle and continuous ratings.
note: Compact evidence projection, not the original full hashed export. Reproduce via POST /api/workbench/v2/powertrain-comparison using request below; original hash covers full previews/provenance.

usable_battery_capacity_kwh.basis: Explicit usable chemical-energy capacity in the selected model snapshot

continuous_motor_power_kw.basis: Declared continuous mechanical shaft rating; used by these experiments

peak_motor_power_kw.basis: Declared peak shaft rating; not the operation policy for these runs

achieved_cycle_distance_km.basis: Achieved constrained movement, not prescribed distance

terminal_consumption_kwh_100km.basis: Descriptive achieved net terminal energy; excludes battery heat

modelled_consumption_kwh_100km.basis: Achieved stored-energy depletion = net terminal energy + battery heat; extrapolation gate applies

cycle_equivalent_range_km.basis: 100 × usable model reservoir kWh / stored-depletion kWh per 100 km; not current-SOC remaining range or certified range

modelled_acceleration_time_s.basis: Observed tick time from zero to the user-selected target under continuous-rating policy

acceleration_final_speed_ms.basis: Achieved final speed in the bounded acceleration run; not maximum sustainable speed

daily_battery_energy_kwh.basis: User daily distance × eligible stored-depletion consumption /100

daily_grid_energy_kwh.basis: Battery depletion energy / explicitly supplied charging efficiency
daily_grid_energy_kwh.reason: No charging-efficiency assumption supplied; grid energy/cost cannot be inferred

daily_battery_energy_cost_eur.basis: User daily distance × eligible stored-depletion consumption /100 × user tariff; battery-energy equivalent only, excludes charging losses

daily_electricity_cost_eur.basis: Battery depletion energy / explicitly supplied charging efficiency × user electricity tariff
daily_electricity_cost_eur.reason: No charging-efficiency assumption supplied; grid energy/cost cannot be inferred

monthly_battery_energy_kwh.basis: User daily distance × eligible stored-depletion consumption /100 × user selected driving days

monthly_grid_energy_kwh.basis: Battery depletion energy / explicitly supplied charging efficiency × user selected driving days
monthly_grid_energy_kwh.reason: No charging-efficiency assumption supplied; grid energy/cost cannot be inferred

monthly_battery_energy_cost_eur.basis: User daily distance × eligible stored-depletion consumption /100 × user tariff; battery-energy equivalent only, excludes charging losses × user selected driving days

monthly_electricity_cost_eur.basis: Battery depletion energy / explicitly supplied charging efficiency × user electricity tariff × user selected driving days
monthly_electricity_cost_eur.reason: No charging-efficiency assumption supplied; grid energy/cost cannot be inferred

limitations: Modelled cycle-equivalent range, not certified EPA/WLTP or real-world range and not remaining range at current SOC.
No top-speed/thermal-endurance solver is implemented; only bounded acceleration and achieved speeds are shown.
Range assumes the same cycle consumption over the full usable model chemical-energy reservoir, with no temperature/ageing/auxiliary model.
Charging efficiency and tariffs are user assumptions. Battery-energy cost is not grid electricity cost when charging efficiency is unknown.
Compact traces are preview-only; full Lab requests and full-result hashes are retained for reproduction, not silently truncated evidence.

source.licence: Original VEUS illustrative fixture; no external vehicle measurements
notes: Explicit synthetic piecewise-linear speed example, sampled at 1 s. Not a standardized or measured journey.
A flat grade=0 assumption is explicit for this synthetic profile; no geographic geometry or surveyed elevation is implied.
